diagnose.title: Analyze Crop Health
diagnose.subtitle: Upload a leaf or crop photograph for instant AI disease identification and action guidance.
diagnose.uploadPhotoSubtitle: Upload a clear, focused photograph of the affected leaf or crop part.
diagnose.analyzingSubtitle: Detecting crop conditions, calculating confidence, and preparing localized recommendations...
diagnose.photoGuideline1: Take a clear, sharp photo in good daylight.
diagnose.photoGuideline2: Focus closely on the affected spots, lesions, or discolorations.
diagnose.photoGuideline3: Avoid blurry, dark, or distant whole-field images.

report.title: Crop Diagnosis Report
report.subtitle: AI-assisted disease analysis, confidence score, and management recommendations.
report.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This diagnosis is generated by an artificial intelligence model based on image analysis and agricultural knowledge retrieval. It is intended for advisory and educational support. Always consult local agricultural authorities (such as KVK) before applying chemical treatments.

actionPlan.title: Weather-Aware Action Plan
actionPlan.subtitle: Localized spray advisories, staged treatments, and AI consultation.
actionPlan.sprayWindowGood: Favorable Spray Window: Conditions suitable for application.
actionPlan.sprayWindowCaution: Caution Window: Monitor wind or rain before spraying.
actionPlan.sprayWindowBad: Unfavorable Window: Do not spray due to high rain risk or strong winds.
actionPlan.askExpertPlaceholder: Ask follow-up questions regarding dosages, spray times, or alternatives...
actionPlan.noActions: No specific actions were returned. Review the crop symptoms with an agricultural expert.
actionPlan.noCautions: No specific cautions were returned. Avoid unverified treatments and follow approved product labels.
actionPlan.costVaries: Actual cost may vary by location
actionPlan.costBasisDefault: Actual cost may vary by location
actionPlan.defaultSummary: Recommendations consider the crop diagnosis and available agricultural guidance.
actionPlan.noSources: No specific institutional advisory links were returned for this consultation. Verify treatment decisions against trusted local agricultural guidance.
actionPlan.footerText: FarmWise AI · Helping you make informed crop-care decisions.

community.title: Community Disease Intelligence
community.subtitle: Real-time, privacy-preserving crop disease surveillance across Indian farming communities.
community.surveillanceDesc: Early warning signals aggregated from anonymous crop diagnoses across districts.
community.privacyDesc: Individual farmer identities, phone numbers, and precise field locations are never shared. Surveillance data is aggregated strictly at district level to protect community growers.
